files.core:
// A Strafer that sees and thinks: a Unitree L2 lidar on the middle channel, an OAK-D Lite depth camera on the
// front one, an inertial unit beside it, and a Raspberry Pi 5 on the rear of the left rail.
Robot strafer_lidar {
    intent "goBILDA Strafer mecanum base carrying a Unitree 4D LiDAR L2, a Luxonis OAK-D Lite, a MinIMU-9 and a Raspberry Pi 5"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Lidar3D lidar(ref = "unitree_4d_lidar_l2", glue = (0, 0, 0.024, 0, 0, 1))
    RGBD camera(ref = "luxonis_oak_d_lite", glue = (0.168, 0, 0.024, 0, 0, 1))
    IMU imu(ref = "pololu_minimu_9_v6", glue = (0.084, 0.156, 0.024, 0, 0, 1))
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", glue = (-0.168, 0.156, 0.024, 0, 0, 1))
}

files.core:
// A Hiwonder ROSOrin as its Standard Kit builds it: the body on four 80 mm mecanum wheels, with the kit's LiDAR
// on the top deck and its depth camera on the plate under the deck's front. The kit is sold without a computer.
Robot rosorin {
    intent "Hiwonder ROSOrin mecanum base with its LiDAR and depth camera"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "hiwonder_rosorin_chassis")

    // The kit's motors, each on its bracket at a wheel.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "hiwonder_520_gearmotor_90_12v", glue = (0.0908915, 0.0619651, 0.0170888, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "hiwonder_520_gearmotor_90_12v", glue = (0.0908915, -0.0618171, 0.0170888, 0, -1, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "hiwonder_520_gearmotor_90_12v", glue = (-0.08064, 0.0619618, 0.0167005, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "hiwonder_520_gearmotor_90_12v", glue = (-0.08064, -0.0618128, 0.0167005, 0, -1, 0))

    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "hiwonder_mecanum_wheel_80mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.091, 0.0871, 0.0171, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "hiwonder_mecanum_wheel_80mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.091, -0.0871, 0.0171, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "hiwonder_mecanum_wheel_80mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.0806, 0.0871, 0.0167, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "hiwonder_mecanum_wheel_80mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.0806, -0.0871, 0.0167, 0, -1, 0))

    Lidar lidar(ref = "hiwonder_rosorin_lidar", glue = (0.0115, 0.0001, 0.1095, 0, 0, 1))
    RGBD camera(ref = "hiwonder_rosorin_depth_camera", glue = (0.0478, 0.0001, 0.0914, 1, 0, 0))
}

// A Romi that sees: a Unitree L2 lidar on the deck over the batteries and an IMU on the rear deck.
Robot romi_lidar {
    intent "Pololu Romi differential base carrying a Unitree 4D LiDAR L2 and a MinIMU-9 inertial unit"

    Diff_two_caster chassis(ref = "pololu_romi_chassis_kit")

    Motor motor_left(ref = "pololu_mini_plastic_gearmotor_120_hp_offset_extended", glue = (0, 0.06269, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_right(ref = "pololu_mini_plastic_gearmotor_120_hp_offset_extended", glue = (0, -0.06269, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Standard wheel_left(ref = "pololu_wheel_70x8mm", glue = (0, 0.0704, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Standard wheel_right(ref = "pololu_wheel_70x8mm", glue = (0, -0.0704, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Caster caster(ref = "pololu_romi_ball_caster", glue = (-0.064, 0, -0.0223, 0, 0, -1))

    Lidar3D lidar(ref = "unitree_4d_lidar_l2", glue = (-0.03, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))
    IMU imu(ref = "pololu_minimu_9_v6", glue = (-0.062, 0.045, -0.01, 0, 0, 1))
}
